Select compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1129278. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
